text: Owner decisions 2026-10-23: (1) no Unicode name normalization in core (not portable across JS/Native); DifferentNames is demoted from sufficient distinctness to a contributory hint, since name mismatch fails open (aliases, partial names, encodings) while NamedReference sameness fails closed. (2) DeicticReference is sufficient only where a typed presence-completeness claim covers the utterance interval, with basis HumanReviewed or a detector with measured per-interval recall and receipt; otherwise deixis is contributory. Both amend ADR 0024; implement as one document slice before S3c.
